title: Bank of England Decision Maker Panel monthly data (October 2026) — firms' expected own-price growth one year ahead, the first survey read after the 10-21 UK CPI and PPI prints
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/decision-maker-panel/2026/september-2026, fetched direct 2026-10-16 (HTTP 200) — the Bank's own September-2026 release (published 02 October 2026) states verbatim 'The next release date for the DMP survey data will be 30 October 2026.' Corroborated the same session by bankofengland.co.uk/decision-maker-panel/2026/october-2026 (HTTP 200), which carries no data and states 'This monthly Decision Maker Panel data will be published on 30 October 2026.' Primary-sourced from the publisher's own schedule, twice; filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy carries FED: for the Federal Reserve and has no slot for a non-Fed central bank — the same gap boe-dmp-2026-10-02 and boe-decision-2026-11-05 are filed under. Checked 2026-10-16
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-10-16, superseding proposals/boe-dmp-2026-10-30.from-uk-ppi-2026-10-21.json (read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md). The proposal's date, tier and symbols: [] all stand and are carried. WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH ADDED: (1) the date is now doubly primary-sourced — the 10-02 release's own 'next release' line plus the Bank's October page — and the sibling event's forward test FT-boe-dmp-2026-10-02-3 (does the November round get a public DMP) passed on exactly this date, so the scarcity argument that made the 10-02 ledger hedge is settled in this release's favour: it IS the last public DMP before the 11-05 vote, six days ahead. (2) The 17 September MPC minutes (fetched direct 2026-10-16) cite the DMP three ways, not one: firms' own-price expectations 'had remained elevated'; one-year-ahead wage growth of 3.4% 'stable since before the start of the conflict'; and forward-looking DMP and Agents' indicators 'had not risen unduly' — so the MPC reads both the price and the wage cell, and the 10-02 ledger's own-price-only framing is widened, not overturned. (3) LATEST DATA (September 2026 release, published 2026-10-02, fieldwork 4-18 September, 1,993 responses, three-month averages): expected own-price growth year-ahead 3.7% (-0.1pp); realised own-price growth 3.7% unchanged; CPI expectations 1y ahead 3.1% and 3y ahead 2.8%, both unchanged; realised wage growth 4.0% and expected wage growth 3.4%, both unchanged; realised employment -0.2%, expected +0.2% (+0.1pp); energy shock: 57% of firms expect to raise prices (-2pp on August, -7pp on April), 7% to lower them. (4) Damping mechanisms unchanged: three-month moving average plus a rotating third of a ~10,400-firm panel, so a headline cannot jump on one month's fieldwork. Tiered LOW and argued, not inherited: UK-only, symbols: [], no house playbook is rates- or sterling-keyed, no measured tape reaction to any DMP release exists in this book. Corridor on the day: eci-q3-2026-10-30 (US Employment Cost Index, confirmed high, 08:30 ET — hours AFTER a London-morning DMP), boj-decision-2026-10-30, japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2026-10-30, uk-blue-book-2026-10-30 and uk-pink-book-2026-10-30 the same day, with fomc-2026-10-28, pce-2026-10-29 and the uk-autumn-budget-2026-10-28 in the two days before. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Ledger: docs/research/events/boe-dmp-2026-10-30.md
